hypothesis: The existing source-preserving executable Gravity Q4_K representation can use persistent device-resident F16 KV images and F16-KV flash attention to cross the TG32 boundary without changing the Mistral continuation.
mechanism: Set HAWKING_GRAVITY_F16_KV=1 on the same source-packed Gravity artifact. Weight bytes, source quantization, tokenizer, prompt, RoPE, sampling and layer schedule remain fixed; only KV cache precision and the attention grammar change.
scope: same exact Mistral source and executable Gravity artifact, same immutable revision, same Apple M3 Ultra and complete-token protocol

promotion_gates.rung_claim_requires: candidate must clear TG32 at 31.25 TPS with complete-token parity and no tail regression

reopen_condition: If F16-KV changes the continuation, fails full-logit parity, adds unacceptable dispatch or prefill work, or remains below 31.25 TPS, retire it and require an executable lower-active-byte representation such as basis/lookup or mean-plus-residual.
